final: SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY a.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(atom_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom AS a2 JOIN molecule AS m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id WHERE m2.label = '+' GROUP BY a2.molecule_id))
